items.title: Some Circumstances in which Resonance is Useful (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Some Circumstances in which Resonance is Useful: a main subheading of 14.10 Resonance, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 37-38.

blocks.text: 1. Microwave oven mein khana garam karna

blocks.alt: Kaala microwave oven saamne se: baen taraf darwaza jis mein amber (bhoori-peeli) shafaf khirki aur chandi rang ki handle patti hai, aur daen taraf control panel par do gol chandi rang ke dials.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.18: Microwave oven (kitab ki Figure 14.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka)

blocks.text: Microwave oven electromagnetic microwaves banata hai (gharelu ovens mein taqreeban 2.45 GHz, wavelength taqreeban 12 cm) aur unhen poore oven mein phaila deta hai. Microwaves khane ke pani ke molecules ko usi frequency par jhulati hain, aur molecules aapas mein takrate hain. Takrao se paida hone wali friction (ragar) pani ki kinetic energy ko heat (garmi) mein badal deti hai, jo khane ko garam karti hai.
Jis khane mein pani ke molecules hon wahi microwave oven mein garam hota hai (Fig. 14.18). Plastic ya glass ke containers (bartan) garam nahi hote kyun ke un mein pani ke molecules nahi hote.

blocks.alt: Lakri ki deewar ke saamne shelf par rakha purana portable radio, oopar handle: baen taraf kaali speaker jaali, daen taraf scale aur laal suee wala tuning dial, aur ek haath tuning knob ghuma raha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.19: Radio (kitab ki Figure 14.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka)

blocks.text: Analogue radio par koi station lagana bhi resonance par based hai: hum radio ka knob ghumate hain. Asal mein is se receiver ke electrical circuit ki natural frequency badalti hai. Jab yeh station ki transmission frequency ke barabar ho jaye to resonance hoti hai, us station se sab se zyada energy absorb (jazb) hoti hai, aur hum sirf wahi station sunte hain. Simple radio Fig. 14.19 mein hai.
Ab kuch halaat jahan resonance se bachna chahiye:

Soldiers (fauji) bridge paar karte waqt qadam mila kar nahi chalte. Agar woh qadam mila kar chalein to ho sakta hai ke qadmon ki frequency bridge ki natural frequency ke barabar ho jaye; resonance se bridge bohat bare amplitude se jhoolne lagay aur gir bhi sakta hai.

Equilibrium (tawazun) ke liye aeroplane do wings (par) ke saath banaya jata hai. Wings par aerodynamic force, turbulence (hawa ke jhatke) aur engine ki thartharahat jaisi forces lagti hain. Agar in forces ki frequency wings ki natural frequency se mil jaye to resonance hogi, jo khatarnak sabit ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text:
• Jis frequency par koi cheez khud jhoolti hai use kitab resonance frequency kehti hai (yahi natural frequency hai, aur isi par resonance hoti hai).
• Piano, violin aur guitar ka sound board taar ki thartharahat ke saath resonate karta hai: taar ki vibrations apni energy saaz ke khokhle lakri ke dabbe (sound box) ko deti hain, dabba resonate kar ke awaz ko unchi aur bharpoor bana deta hai.
• Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) mein taqatwar radio-frequency waves nuclei ko jhulati hain aur nuclei energy absorb karte hain; absorb hui energy ke pattern (naqshe) se computer body ke andar ki picture (tasveer) banata hai.
• Jhoole ko us ki natural frequency par baar baar dhakka dein to us ka amplitude barhta jata hai: dhakkon ki frequency jhoole ki natural frequency se milti hai.

blocks.prompt: Soldiers bridge paar karte waqt qadam mila kar kyun nahi chalte?
blocks.explanation: Qadam mila kar chalna bridge par ek periodic force lagata hai. Agar is ki frequency bridge ki natural frequency se mil jaye to resonance se bridge ka amplitude khatarnak had tak barh sakta hai aur bridge gir sakta hai.

items: Resonance: driving frequency = natural frequency, to amplitude bohat bara.
Useful: microwave oven, radio tuning, musical instruments ke sound boards, MRI, jhoole ko dhakka.
Harmful (nuqsandeh): bridge par qadam mila kar chalna, aeroplane ke wings par forces, earthquake mein buildings.
